name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Acrylic LED Night Light
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium clear acrylic with a 2-layer design, creating a beautiful dimensional effect when illuminated.
    - The acrylic panels are precisely laser-cut into custom shapes, giving the product a modern and eye-catching appearance.
    - Comes with a high-quality wooden LED base, designed to hold the acrylic plaque upright for a stable display securely.
    - Built-in energy-efficient LED lighting enhances the printed design while providing a soft and relaxing glow.
    - Smoothly polished edges ensure a clean finish and safe handling.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 2 sizes:
                   +) 5.9 × 5.9 in ~ 15 × 15 cm  → Wooden LED base: 15 x 4 x 3 cm ~ 5.9 x 1.57 x 1.18 in.
                  +) 7.87 × 7.87 in ~ 20 × 20 cm → Wooden LED base: 20 x 4 x 3 cm ~ 7.87 x 1.57 x 1.18 in.
    - The acrylic plaque is designed to perfectly fit the LED wooden base for a balanced and stable display.
    📌 Note:  The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Supports 1-sided or 2-sided printing, allowing the design to be visible from both front and back views.
    - The artwork is printed directly onto the acrylic surface, ensuring high-definition graphics and long-lasting color quality.
    - The 2-layer acrylic structure enhances the lighting effect, making the design appear more vivid when illuminated.
    - The printing process ensures excellent durability and resistance to fading over time.
     
  • Lighting Options:
    - Equipped with a built-in LED wooden base that provides soft and energy-efficient lighting.
    - Available with single-color light or multi-color LED options to suit different decorative preferences.
    - The gentle LED glow highlights the artwork while creating a warm and relaxing atmosphere.
    - Powered via USB connection, making it convenient for everyday use.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a custom decorative LED night light that highlights personalized photos, names, or meaningful messages.
    - Perfect for placing on desks, bedside tables, shelves, or office décor spaces.
    - The illuminated acrylic design combines functional lighting with decorative art, making it a unique home décor piece.
    - The glowing acrylic effect creates a beautiful visual display both day and night.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and personalized gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine’s Day, Christmas, or housewarming celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves custom décor and sentimental keepsakes.
    - Combines modern lighting design with emotional value, making it a memorable decorative gift. 🎁

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
